capabilities: work with daily notes and notes via URL calls
get search results through URL actions
extras: Detailed endpoint documentation lives outside the README; the README also includes maintainer-facing release workflow instructions and references a plugin project status page.
intentEvidence: a clean, super-charged addition to the built-in Obsidian URIs
problem: The built-in Obsidian URI scheme covers only a few actions, so external automation tools can't trigger common tasks like opening daily notes or fetching search results.
summary: URL handler plugin that adds x-callback-url endpoints to Obsidian for actions on daily notes, notes, and searches.
